Compose_TriagePrompt.inputs:
@concat('Triage this ticket from the automated intake flow.

[TRIAGE_REQUEST]
ticketId: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']), '
ticketSpItemId: ', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']), '
callerUpn: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Caller/Email'], last(split(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Caller/Claims'],'|'),'|')), ''), '
callerName: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Caller/DisplayName'], ''), '
shortDescription: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/ShortDescription'], triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], ''), '
description: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Description'], ''), '
openedDate: ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Created'], ''), variables('accumulatedContext'), '

Apply your standard ITSM classification. Reply with EXACTLY the tagged JSON block in this format and NOTHING ELSE — no chat, no preamble, no follow-up question:\n\n<<<TRIAGE_BEGIN>>>\n{ "outcome": "...", ... }\n<<<TRIAGE_END>>>')

Get_FallbackApprovers.description: Reads the FallbackApprovers row from the ITSM Config list (same governance as the Dispatcher kill-switch). PRE-DEPLOY: this row must be seeded with a semicolon UPN list (Baker@flowstudio.app) before the flow is enabled, or escalation CreateAnApproval will fail (assignedTo empty).

Compose_Approver_Upn.description: Pilot - fixed primary approver. Phase 3.2 (APR-5) resolves dynamic manager via Office 365 Users Manager_V2; kept identical to Request lane so APR-5 is a single edit across both lanes.

Compose_Fallback_Upn.description: ITSM Approvers fallback pool (semicolon UPN list) from Config row Key=FallbackApprovers. Empty until seeded -> deploy is gated on that seed (Baker@flowstudio.app).

Compose_Provisioning_Approval_Details.inputs: @{concat('**Ticket:** ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], ''), ' (item ID ', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']), ')', decodeUriComponent('%0A'),'**Provisioning job:** ', outputs('Generate_JobId'), decodeUriComponent('%0A'),'**Job type:** ', coalesce(body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['proposedAction']?['jobType'], '(unknown)'), decodeUriComponent('%0A'),'**Target user:** ', coalesce(body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['targetUserUpn'], body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['callerUpn'], triggerOutputs()?['body/Caller/Email'], '(unknown)'), decodeUriComponent('%0A'),'**Risk:** ', coalesce(string(body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['risk']), '(n/a)'), '   **Confidence:** ', coalesce(string(body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['confidence']), '(n/a)'), decodeUriComponent('%0A%0A'),'**Short description:** ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/ShortDescription'], ''), decodeUriComponent('%0A%0A'),'**Agent rationale:** ', coalesce(body('Parse_FinalTriageJson')?['rationale'], '(none)'), decodeUriComponent('%0A%0A'),'**Tracking:** [Open ticket](https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/ITSM/Lists/Tickets/DispForm.aspx?ID=', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']), ')')}
Compose_Provisioning_Approval_Details.description: Human-readable provisioning approval body rendered from the agent triage JSON.

Get_Ticket.description: Re-read the live ticket immediately before the On-Hold patch. This branch can run 24-48h after the trigger fired, so the trigger snapshot is stale; GetItem confirms the row still exists and lets the next action patch only 2 fields without clobbering caller edits.

Hold_Ticket.description: Minimal patch: ticket -> On Hold, HoldReason 'Awaiting Approval'. Sources Title + ShortDescription from the preceding GetItem so a stale 24-48h trigger snapshot can never overwrite caller edits.

parameters.body/messageBody: @{concat('Heads up - your provisioning request on ticket ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'],''), ' was not approved. The ticket is now On Hold (Awaiting Approval). The approver declined the request. Open the ticket: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/ITSM/Lists/Tickets/DispForm.aspx?ID=', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']))}

Notify_Caller_Teams.description: Notify the caller in Teams (Flow-bot DM) that the provisioning approval did not pass and the ticket is On Hold. Paired with an Outlook email (Notify_Caller_Outlook) so the caller is reached on BOTH channels per Catherine's request.

Notify_Caller_Outlook.description: Notify the caller by Outlook email (Office 365 Outlook, catherine.han connection) that the provisioning approval did not pass and the ticket is On Hold. Runs after the Teams DM with [Succeeded, Failed] so neither channel blocks the other. Catherine asked for BOTH Teams AND Outlook; both are now wired.

parameters.ApprovalCreationInput/details: @{concat('**ESCALATED** - primary approver (', outputs('Compose_Approver_Upn'), ') did not respond within 24h.', decodeUriComponent('%0A%0A'), outputs('Compose_Provisioning_Approval_Details'))}

Escalate_On_Timeout.description: Wait #1 timed out (no response in 24h). Escalate once to the ITSM Approvers fallback pool, wait another 24h. Second timeout auto-REJECTS (PJ Rejected + ticket On Hold + notify caller). Never auto-approve. (ADR 0002 / approval spec sec.7)

description: REVERT NOTIF-1: removed the Clarifier wiring from the Triage-Orchestrator. Deleted If_StopAndAsk (Update_Ticket_AwaitingCaller + Fire_Clarifier_Child + Set_Outcome_AwaitingCaller) from Triage_Loop and the no-op Outcome_AwaitingCaller Switch case. The triage agent's stop_and_ask outcome now falls through to the Branch_FinalOutcome default (Update_Ticket_OnUnknownOutcome -> On Hold / Awaiting Caller / routed to human queue), restoring pre-NOTIF-1 behaviour. The Clarifier child is owned exclusively by the Ticket-Type Validator. #flowstudio-mcp
